description: This is a PHP class file defining the KpiService class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin, responsible for managing KPI entities, including saving KPIs with validation and transaction management.

classes.name: KpiService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling KPI-related operations, including saving KPIs with validation and transaction support.

methods.name: getKpiDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the KpiDao instance used for database operations related to KPI entities.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Validates and saves a KPI entity. Throws exceptions on validation failure or transaction errors. Manages database transaction boundaries.
